name: Uesugi Kenshin
source:
Hobby: Simulating Castle Sieges
Special Skill: Swordplay
Charm Point: Communication by crossing swords

Called "The God of War" due to his thirst for battle, his natural charisma has gained him many followers. He has a strong sense of duty and always keeps his promises. He's cold to women, but could there be a reason why?

"I was born to die fighting. I don't have time for women."

[from the app]
